status: Called in by Secretary of State
decision_conditions:
You are advised that condition 2 of Prior Approval P2025/1604/PRA as introduced by this non-material amendment is as follows:

DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS: The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

W01 (Location and Site Plan); W03 (Proposed Ground Floor and Basement Plan); W04/A (Proposed Elevations); Noise Assessment dated May 2025 by NRG Consulting; Internal Daylight Assessment dated May 2025 by NRG Consulting; Planning Statement dated 22/05/2025 by Planning Insight Ltd & Heritage Note dated June 2025 by AndHeritage Ltd

REASON: To comply with Section 70(1)(a) of the Town and Country Act 1990 as amended and the Reason for Grant and also for the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
description: Non-Material Amendment to Prior Approval ref. P2025/1604/PRA dated 29/07/2025 (‘Change of use of ground floor and basement from Class E (retail) to Class C3 (dwellinghouses) to provide 1no. flat’) in order to insert a condition to list the approved drawings and documents.
